#: SteamVR's render models read from its install, on the stand-in (run.py --cases render-models --expect expect/render_models.json; run.py makes tests/unit/data/steamvr, our own fixture, SteamVR's install for this case). The fixture's models are listed with the built-in ones it doesn't have. test_controller has no OBJ of its own, so it is its two components together (a four-cornered plate and a triangle: 7 vertices, 3 triangles) with its 2x2 PNG, also as a D3D11 texture. Each component's render model is <model>/<component>; the trigger (controller_axis 1, so Axis1's button bit) turns -20 degrees about X through its pivot when pulled, its local frame with it; the body is static at its component_local. The thumbnail is the JSON's, as a file URL; the original path is the model's OBJ. vive_tracker's JSON isn't JSON: the built-in tracker (10659 vertices, no texture) is answered.
